events.body:
## Bug

`website/views/issue.py` references `SocialToken` at lines 2694, 2712 and 2713 (e.g. `SocialToken.objects.filter(account__user=request.user, account__provider="github")` in `dispatch()` of the GitHub-issue view), but `SocialToken` is never imported in the module. Any request to that view raises `NameError: name 'SocialToken' is not defined` on dispatch.

## Repro

Open the GitHub-issue view (the `github_issue.html` view) as a logged-in user → NameError at line 2694.

## Suggested fix

    from allauth.socialaccount.models import SocialToken

Found by static analysis (ruff F821); no star-import masks the name. AI model used in analysis: Claude Opus 4.8 (Claude Code).
